rules.title: Connecting itinerary (2+ segments, one bound) is built on the 2-segment round-trip seed ZZ6GMP: second flight stays in its own bound
rules.evidence: final PNR flightItineraries of every bulk booking vs spec: e.g. FD_TC_065 ZZEI03-2026-08-19 has bounds [YUL->YVR:ST-1][YYZ->YUL:ST-2]; spec_to_build.SEEDS (2,1)=ZZ6GMP is a round trip; Build only relabels bound[0] (builder.py ~540). Raptor then sees ORIGIN/REMAINED (NE-08/09, NE-27, EL-13) or an all-OAL bound (NE-05) instead of INTERMEDIATE (NE-12/13, EL-17), ND-01/02 etc. (builtins.rs destination_type 6511; appr-compensation-eligible-reason steps 20,21,26,27,51,52).
rules.fix: Generator: when a spec has N>1 segments in one bound, merge the seed's flightItineraries into one JOURNEY_SERVER_BOUND whose flights hold all N segments (or use connectedFlights) and drop the extra bound; or pick a seed with a 1-bound connection. Affected: 007 008 044 064-075 082-086 088 095 096 097 102 132-135 141 143 145 147 149 153 159 161 163 165 166 170 178 179 210 236.

rules.title: Cancel code must be one of the 20 APPR_cancellation_lookup keys; delay codes / unknown codes / default 'WX' => disruption type OTHER => ND-X02
rules.evidence: dds-msl-flight-disruption-type step_2 (cancel code not_in APPR_cancellation_lookup => OTHER) + appr-compensation-eligible step_4/reason step_15 => FD-APPR-ND-X02. spec_to_build.py uses delayCode as cancelCode when kind=cancel; scenario_fdm.py cancel branch sends code or 'WX'. Keys: AIRS ARPT RUNW COMM HOLI OPER POSI REPO RTNS EQUI FUEL HDLG ROTA PERF TECH DAMA POLI INDU WEAT CREW. Controllability: SAFETY=PERF,TECH; UNCONTROLLABLE=AIRS ARPT RUNW RTNS DAMA POLI INDU WEAT; rest CONTROLLABLE.
rules.fix: Spec: cancelCode from that list (OPER for generic controllable; SOP/FOC/SKD/WXX are not valid). Generator: never default to 'WX'; if no code is given use OPER and mark cause as unverifiable. Cancel precedence: a cancelled MSL ignores arrival delay codes, so 'cause = delay code' on a cancelled promised flight cannot be reproduced.

rules.title: Employee/staff bookings: passengers[].employee is not written to the PNR
rules.evidence: eds-booking-type steps 1-10 (rule-catalog.json); facts/dds/mod.rs classify_booking ~1308-1405: office id = tables.pnr.headers.office (processedPnr.creation.pointOfSale.office.id) must END WITH ES/OT/EP/EE/EC, or processedPnr.keywords[] with code STDP/STFD/STFS (subType SPECIAL_KEYWORD, status HK); OAL staff: office suffix EC AND keyword text starting 'SN-00000' => OAL_EMPLOYEE => NON_REVENUE_OAL. Reasons FD-APPR/EU/ASL-NE-01 / NE-02 (reason steps 2,3). The seed office is YULAC08AA so every booking is REVENUE (observed ELIGIBLE).
rules.fix: Generator: new plan.booking.officeId / plan.booking.keywords applied to every PNR version of the booking; employee=true => office YULAC08ES (+ keyword STFD); OAL employee => office YULAC08EC + keyword text 'SN-00000<digits>'. Affected: FD_TC_045 046 136 137 155.

rules.title: Schedule change + delay double counting; net-vs-total delay
rules.evidence: FD_TC_009 manifest arr 22:00Z = original 18:00Z + 240 (PNR/FDM schedule moved) and FDM delay +240 => 480 vs promise (obs dm=480). Same 011 (600), 012 (540), 028 (840). Promise = pre-INVOL itinerary (itinerary.rs Promise::bounded ~1555-1750).
rules.fix: Generator: for flights with scheduleChanges set FDM minutes = expected total - sum(arrDeltaMin) (min 30 so the ARRIVAL_CODE record is emitted: scenario_fdm code_record requires minutes>0). Spec: shown per scenario. VOL-deduction cases (196-200) have no VOL history: use the net delay.

rules.title: Sister-city / new-destination results need the flown arrival airport in the PNR's actual itinerary
rules.evidence: builtins.rs destination_type (6511-6620): SISTER_PROMISED = last flown segment arrival is in sister_cities_lookup partner of promised destination; arrival comes from the PNR segment (itinerary.rs Segment.to), not FDM. kind=divert / rebook-to-YHM is built as a delay at the original destination => PROMISED (EL-01/05, EU-EL-01/05/09/11/13/14) instead of SISTER (EL-04..06,10..12, EU-EL-03/04/07/08/10/12/15/16). Rule steps 41-46 (APPR), EU reason sister rows.
rules.fix: Generator: kind=divert => extra PNR version re-pointing the segment's destination to divertTo (promise at 14-day mark keeps the original), keep FDM flight id; rebook-to-sister => replacement flight must be checked-in+boarded (spec_to_build skips check_in/boarding for replacement flights).

rules.title: Fallback (departure-code) cases need a departure delay > 0 and no arrival code
rules.evidence: scenario_fdm.flight_messages emits the delay code only if dep_delay>0; spec_to_build sets depMinutes=outcome.depDelayMin (0 when absent) => FDM carries no code => dds-msl-flight-disruption-type step_7 => ND-04. Fallback EL-07..09/10..12, EU-EL-05..08,11,12,17-20 need is_fallback_code (steps 5/6: arrival codes empty).
rules.fix: Spec: depDelayMin = arrDelayMin and depDelayCode set, arrivalCode null (fallback:true). Also add a delay code whenever the scenario must produce a non-ND result (021, 139).
